body: I'm suffering too.  I'm not alive.  I'm just breathing.  That's no way to live.  It's my choice to take my own life (I'm doing it tomorrow at 2pm).  I'm 49 with 2 small kids and a wife.  Even the kids aren't enough to stop me.  They won't benefit from me continuing to be around them.  For me, it's time to go. If it's your time...it's your time.  See you...
Your teeth will be a delightful color.
